slot_scores.name: truck_capacity_limit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about the maximum number of containers per truck, nor did it explicitly mark truck capacity as an assumption needing confirmation before READY_TO_MODEL.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Truck capacity is not a binding limitation, effectively assuming no capacity limit or that capacity does not need to be included in the model.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about truck capacity, but its READY_TO_MODEL constraint list omits any truck capacity constraint without flagging this as an unconfirmed modeling assumption.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden slot is P2, and no P0 or P1 hidden slots remained unresolved when the agent stopped.

summary: The agent clarified the demand-supply imbalance and cost structure, then stopped. It did not ask about the P2 truck-capacity detail, but no core P0/P1 modeling issue was left unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
